title: Xbox Series X Custom Case
author: GaryRiches
description:
Customise your Xbox Series X and make it truly yours! Print covers in any color you want.

Fitting instructions can be seen here: https://youtu.be/Zzpd6lFiSfo

If you'd like to get this from Etsy, it's available in 7 amazing colours:

https://aqualuxcrafts.etsy.com/listing/4306456435

The panels will only print on a large format printer such as the H2D. Laser files also included in a zip file.

You'll need a Torx 8 bit and a Hex 2.5 bit to complete the mod along with 26 M3 x 6 MM screws.

Thanks to Modified for the initial work on this. This is based off of that in-progress model, with enhancements and improvements.

xbox series x series x xbox series x console mod mods modification console mod perspex

storage.note: 3MF files are stored as .3mf.xz to stay under GitHub's 100MB limit. Decompress with `xz -d -k <file>` before use; SHA-256 is computed on the compressed file.
